tools.name: search_diamonds
tools.description: Search certified diamonds listed by retailers worldwide, with the latest cross-retailer prices we have seen. tools.name: get_diamond
tools.description: Details and the latest confirmed price range for one diamond, with the date we last saw it, by its Carat Hunter id (from search_diamonds or a carathunter.com URL).

tools.name: lookup_certificate
tools.description: Find a diamond by its grading report number (GIA, IGI, HRD, GCAL...). Tells you whether retailers list that exact stone, how many, and the price range between them as of the date we last saw it. Useful to check whether a quoted price is fair.

tools.name: price_check
tools.description: Typical listed prices for a spec (carat size, colour, clarity, shape, origin) across all retailers Carat Hunter tracks, with the day they were measured: median, middle-half range, and how much the same stone varies between retailers. Carat sizes: 0.3, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5.

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: How many diamonds and retailers Carat Hunter currently tracks, from its latest weekly market report.
